Q: How can I get a Excel sheet in Word but the content is variable A:

Your description is too vague.

Depending what you are trying to achieve, you could embed an Excel workbook with the appropriate formulae in your document. All the data entry and calculations would then be done in the internal workbook, which you could activate by double-clicking on it.

Alternatively, you could just copy & paste a range from an external workbook, using paste special with the 'paste link' method and your preferred paste format. All the data entry and calculations would then be done in the external workbook.

Other solutions are also possible but, as I said, your description is too vague.

Q: Contact form "Undefined value was submitted through this field." A:

Easy fix for me. Just changed the field name into something else. There was a conflict with the name I believe.

I had

[checkbox* service_type use_label_element "Flooring" "Cleaning Services" "Tile Installation" "Other"]

and I just changed service_type into service_type123. Everything works fine. I hope it helps.

Q: Is this modular scikit-learn pipeline design correct for a binary classification task? A:

  1. Load data

  2. Preprocess

    1. Check missing values

    2. remove duplicates

    3. handle inconsistencies

  3. Do some basic visualisation (especially correlation) to understand the data

  4. Split into train and test sets

  5. Apply scaling (fit only on training data)

  6. Train and evaluate models

Right now;

  • You are doing scaling before train-test split, It can cause data leakage

  • Correlation is used directly for feature selection without proper EDA

  • No actual visualisation is done, even though plotting is imported

Q: TRIM_HORIZON vs LATEST A:

Starting position only matters on first run. After that, EventBridge Pipes use checkpoints.

Lets assume your application (application-name) is connected to an eventbridge pipe as a target where the source is a kinesis data stream. let's also assume there are no filters/enrichment here for simplicity.
say you have a few records in your stream already. now when you connect (start) your pipe for the first time to this stream, the starting position TRIM HORIZON or LATEST simply tells you what records will be sent by your pipe to your application for downstream processing.
TRIM_HORIZON:start processing all records that exist on the stream.
LATEST:ignore all records that exist on the stream and start from records that land in the stream going forward.
There are a few other starting position available as well.

Now lets say you stop your pipe to change some configurations that require the pipe to be stopped (eg:update or add filters, targets,etc.) and then reconnect (start) your pipe. Suppose during this window when the pipe was stopped there were a few more records ingested in the stream. The pipe will now remember the last record it processed (checkpoint) and pickup any records post that as per the sequence number to send to your application.
so the starting position only affects what records are sent to your application when the pipe is connected to the stream for the first time. All subsequent connections of the same pipe to the stream, will honour the checkpoints. Checkpoints are not affected by starting position.

  - If you delete and recreate the pipe (not just stop/start), checkpoints are lost and starting position applies again
  - Kinesis default retention is 24 hours (up to 365 days). If your pipe is stopped for longer than retention, those checkpoints become invalid.
